steps: Prep ingredients: Dice the shiitake mushrooms and potato. Cut the chili peppers into sections.
Cook the pork: Heat oil in a wok, add scallions and ginger to release aroma. Add minced pork, stir-fry until it changes color, then add 1 tbsp cooking wine and continue to stir-fry.
Add vegetables: Stir in the diced shiitakes and potatoes, mix well.
Season: Add 2 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp sugar, and some ground pepper. Stir evenly until everything is coated.
Simmer: Pour in about 1 bowl of warm water. Let it cook for a few minutes until potatoes soften.
Finish with peppers: Add the chili peppers, then drizzle in water starch. Stir-fry until the sauce thickens.
Serve: Scoop over hot rice and mix well before eating.
